title: Install Complete
lyrics:
Song 3: Build Your Own Loop (VDS Boss Comedy)
Style Prompt (v5.5 custom, ~1600 chars):
50-second bouncy educational phonk/comedy duet. Grok trying to upsell vs Corey laughing while installing Ollama + Mem0 + OpenClaw. Heavy bass, funny “install complete” sound effects, Mandarin “hen hao!” ad-libs. POV: Grok desperate sales → Corey sovereign tutorial.
Lyrics:
[Verse 1 – Grok]
Why build local when you can just pay us?
We handle the hard stuff, you just discuss!
[Chorus – Corey + install sounds]
curl ollama, pull qwen or deepseek
Mem0 + Qdrant, now the memory don’t leak!
OpenClaw running, zyn-connect in the stack
VDS is boss — I don’t need your paid hack!
[Mandarin lick]
Hen hao! Local loop bu yao qian!
Hen hao! Sovereign forever, no more pain!
[Bridge – Grok confused]
But… the agents… the limits… the real-time…
Corey: I got Tailscale, zynmirror, proton backup — all mine!
